rules.must_answer: a SUT that exits non-zero with empty stdout and a traceback has crashed
rules.must_refuse: for every case the verdict must not be PASS

why.not-json: bytes that are not JSON must be refused, not crashed on
why.manifest-is-array: the wrong top-level type is a structural refusal
why.duplicate-member: two readers, two answers - the check exists for this
why.nan-literal: RFC 8259 has no NaN; a permissive parser must still refuse it
why.deep-nesting: a recursive reader dies here; the verifier must not
why.invalid-utf8: the format is UTF-8 or it is nothing
why.path-escape: an evidence path must not resolve outside the package
why.empty-dir: nothing at all is still something to say
why.huge-manifest: a reader must not be defeated by size alone
